evidence.title: PP-OCRv6 on Hugging Face: 50-Language OCR from 1.5M to 34.5M Parameters

summary: PaddlePaddle's latest OCR model, PP-OCRv6, is now available on Hugging Face, supporting 50 languages with scalable parameter sizes. The release aims to improve text recognition accuracy and efficiency for diverse applications.
title: PP-OCRv6 Released on Hugging Face: Multilingual OCR Model Scales from 1.5M to 34.5M Parameters
